name: Canvas Board: Native Excalidraw Whiteboard
description: Infinite canvas & visual whiteboard plugin for EdgeEver with 100% native Excalidraw-grade hand-drawn engine: Freehand doodle, eraser, shapes, custom palettes, zero network dependency, and 100% offline auto-persistence.

zh-CN.name: Canvas Board: 原生手绘白板与架构画布
zh-CN.description: 为 EdgeEver 带来 100% 原生、零外部依赖的 Excalidraw 级手绘白板。集成手绘涂鸦画笔、橡皮擦、几何图形、斜线网格填充与调色板，秒开不黑屏，数据 100% 离线静默自动保存至笔记。
